title: Fixed-point sets of semifree group actions on infinite-dimensional compact convex sets and their manifolds
summary: Let $A$ be the fixed point set of a semifree action of a compact (metric) group $G$ on a Keller space $X$ (an infinite-dimensional compact convex subset of a separable Fr\' echet space). All Keller spaces are homeomorphic and all nontrivial compact Lie groups act on all $X$'s semifreely with unique fixed points (see Section 3). We prove (1) if $A$ is a single point, then it is the fixed point set of a semifree action of $G$ with uniformly small orbits, (2) if $A$ has Property Z (e.g., is of infinite codimension) in $X$, then the action of $G$ may be replaced by one with fixed point set $A$…
